story.text: Wentworth is soon at home at Uppercross, and Charles’s sisters, Louisa and Henrietta, are both half in love with him. One morning Anne is {NURSING} Mary’s {SICK} little boy, hurt in a fall, when his {BROTHER}, a {ROMPING} two-year-old, climbs onto her {BACK} and will not let go. Suddenly someone lifts him off: Wentworth, {SILENTLY}. Anne cannot even {THANK} him.
story.caption: Some one was taking him from her
